title: Thacker Pass Air Permit Technical Review
summary: NDEP's technical review records the emissions estimates, modeling, permitting decisions, and state and federal requirements used for the Thacker Pass air permit.
key_findings: The review documents the technical basis for the air-permitting decision.
It exposes modeling assumptions and expected emissions for later comparison.
Expected emissions and permit modeling are not measured operating emissions.
why_it_matters: It supplies the baseline needed to audit later test and monitoring data.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the model and assumptions behind the permit.
Supports later variance checks against measured emissions.
Preserves forecast, limit, and observation as separate evidence stages.
evidence_limits: The review predates later construction and operating performance.
It does not establish current permit status, compliance, production, or local outcomes.
